list.label: strategy
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "strategy", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "strategy_signals" and r.schema_version == "${schema_version}", start: -30d)

list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "strategy_signals")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.schema_version == "${schema_version}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "signal_strength")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.strategy =~ /${strategy:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.asset =~ /${asset:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.timeframe =~ /${timeframe:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${signal_type:regex}" == ".*" then true else r.signal_type =~ /${signal_type:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${side}" == "both" then true else r.side == "${side}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${run_id}" == "latest" then true else r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if exists r.sample then r.sample == "${sample}" else true)
  |> count()
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "strategy_signals" and r._field == "signal_strength")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.schema_version == "${schema_version}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.strategy =~ /${strategy:regex}/ and r.asset =~ /${asset:regex}/ and r.timeframe =~ /${timeframe:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${side}" == "both" then true else r.side == "${side}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${run_id}" == "latest" then true else r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if exists r.sample then r.sample == "${sample}" else true)
  |> mean()

import "date"
last_signal = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "strategy_signals" and r._field == "signal_strength")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.schema_version == "${schema_version}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.strategy =~ /${strategy:regex}/ and r.asset =~ /${asset:regex}/ and r.timeframe =~ /${timeframe:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${side}" == "both" then true else r.side == "${side}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${run_id}" == "latest" then true else r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if exists r.sample then r.sample == "${sample}" else true)
  |> last()
last_signal
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: uint(v: date.sub(d: r._time, from: now()))) / 60000000000.0 }))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -90d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "strategy_performance" and r._field == "win_rate")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.schema_version == "${schema_version}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.strategy =~ /${strategy:regex}/ and r.asset =~ /${asset:regex}/ and r.timeframe =~ /${timeframe:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.benchmark == "${benchmark}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if exists r.sample then r.sample == "${sample}" else true)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if exists r.side and "${side}" != "both" then r.side == "${side}" else true)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${run_id}" == "latest" then true else r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "strategy_signals" and r._field == "signal_strength")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.schema_version == "${schema_version}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.strategy =~ /${strategy:regex}/ and r.asset =~ /${asset:regex}/ and r.timeframe =~ /${timeframe:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${signal_type:regex}" == ".*" then true else r.signal_type =~ /${signal_type:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${side}" == "both" then true else r.side == "${side}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${run_id}" == "latest" then true else r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if exists r.sample then r.sample == "${sample}" else true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "signal_strength")

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "strategy_signals" and r._field == "signal_strength")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.schema_version == "${schema_version}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.strategy =~ /${strategy:regex}/ and r.asset =~ /${asset:regex}/ and r.timeframe =~ /${timeframe:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${signal_type:regex}" == ".*" then true else r.signal_type =~ /${signal_type:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${side}" == "both" then true else r.side == "${side}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${run_id}" == "latest" then true else r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if exists r.sample then r.sample == "${sample}" else true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "signal_count")

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "strategy_signals")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.schema_version == "${schema_version}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.strategy =~ /${strategy:regex}/ and r.asset =~ /${asset:regex}/ and r.timeframe =~ /${timeframe:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${signal_type:regex}" == ".*" then true else r.signal_type =~ /${signal_type:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${side}" == "both" then true else r.side == "${side}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${run_id}" == "latest" then true else r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if exists r.sample then r.sample == "${sample}" else true)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "strategy", "asset", "timeframe", "run_id", "side", "signal_type"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "strategy", "asset", "timeframe", "run_id", "side", "signal_type", "signal_strength", "confidence", "price", "quantity"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 20)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "strategy_signals" and r._field == "signal_strength")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.schema_version == "${schema_version}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.strategy =~ /${strategy:regex}/ and r.asset =~ /${asset:regex}/ and r.timeframe =~ /${timeframe:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${side}" == "both" then true else r.side == "${side}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${run_id}" == "latest" then true else r.run_id == "${run_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if exists r.sample then r.sample == "${sample}" else true)
  |> group(columns: ["signal_type"])
  |> count()
  |> keep(columns: ["signal_type", "_value"])
